note: gx-music slots (src/ui3.js musicInit). Files go to games/vinegrave/music/<slot>-a.mp3 and -b.mp3; build.py picks up whatever exists.

tavern.prompt: Calm jungle-expedition title theme: marimba, soft hand drums, wooden flute and distant birdsong, warm and curious, 1920s adventure feel. 90 seconds, seamless loop. No vocals. Make 2 versions (a and b).

main.prompt: Light exploring loop for a thinking board game: plucked strings, kalimba, shaker and low hand drum, steady mid tempo, unobtrusive so players can concentrate. 120 seconds, seamless loop. No vocals. Make 2 versions (a and b).

fight.prompt: Tense jungle chase loop for a boss stage: deep tribal-style drums, low brass swells, staccato strings, mysterious but not scary. 90 seconds, seamless loop. No vocals. Make 2 versions (a and b).

victory.prompt: Short triumphant expedition fanfare: bright brass and marimba run ending on a warm major chord, 6 to 8 seconds, no loop, no vocals. Make 2 versions (a and b).

defeat.prompt: Short gentle defeat sting: soft descending marimba and a muted horn, wistful not sad, 5 to 6 seconds, no loop, no vocals. Make 2 versions (a and b).
